name: Aspen Electronics Manufacturing Inc.
old_description: Many companies claim it, yet we live by it. At each stage of product delivery, we stand by our word.
about:
Aspen Electronics Manufacturing Inc. operates from Westminster, Colorado. The company has grown responsibly for 26 consecutive years, though a founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership structure and founders are not specified in available sources.

The shop provides printed circuit board assembly services spanning surface-mount and through-hole technologies, component sourcing, prototyping, and functional testing. Capabilities include hand placement of leaded and surface-mount parts, automated fine-pitch and BGA placement, in-circuit test, full unit build, cable and harness assembly, and automated optical inspection (AOI) with optical character recognition on all SMT components. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not disclosed.

Aspen Electronics serves customers requiring ITAR-compliant manufacturing, as evidenced by its registration with the U.S. Department of Defense. The company's engineering-driven approach puts customers in direct contact with a manager who has an engineering background, eliminating internal translation of technical requirements.

The company emphasizes a lean manufacturing system integrated across all processes, targeting a defect rate near zero through thorough functional testing. It promotes fair pricing supported by supplier relationships and commits to on-time delivery, with staff often working overtime to meet deadlines.
